segments.text: A reclusive, altruistic boy. Always positive. He can see the world as numbers. People's measurements are thus clear as day to him.
A scientist doing some research in an old lab. He's abnormally passionate about muscles. Well, nothing about him is normal, really.

The girl working at the CD shop. Natsukage's older sister. Her personality and attitude are bad. Real bad. She only hears what she wants to, which is bad too. But she is popular with certain customers.
A princely part-timer. Has many female fans due to his personality. Kind of spontaneous, but he does good work. Works a couple of jobs at once, it seems.
A half-Japanese albino girl. Still studying Japanese, so she speaks awkwardly. Her cheeriness redeems it, but she's also reckless. She likes cute things, sweet things, and hard-workers.
A woman working as a guide at 307 Tower. Always distanced and not very emotional. But she knows that's bad, and is practically always smiling. She also has a cruel side.
A famous novelist. His books are very popular and have gotten movies, but he hardly cares and just wants to die. He enjoys the coldness of 307 Towers's halls.
A self-declared alien boy who plays Sea-Sky-Run. His speed is said to be world-class, but he doesn't really care and just does it for fun. Not particularly bright, it seems.
The sweet old lady at the candy store. Tends to the store with her cat Hanako. She lives with many other cats, too.
The lady running the drugstore. Recent hobbies include hanafuda (a type of card game) and flirting. Has two younger siblings.

A boy who plays Sky-Sea-Run. Used to change clothes but he practices daily, and it's a pain to do, so he stopped doing so. This means he's always sopping wet. His favorite ice cream flavor is choco-banana.
The shrine maiden at Komainu Shrine. Peaceful and relaxed. Deeply faithful and trusting, so easily-fooled.
The policeman at Mamedanuki Station. Serious with a strong sense of justice. No resistance for offbeat occurrences, so he's often taken aback. Gets constant stomach aches.
The woman running the ramen shop. Wild and dependable. Great at making ramen, so she gets many regulars. Holds her drinks well, so she sometimes has drinking contests with customers.
The brother of the Yakumo twins.
Though he's her brother, he likes thinking up pranks behind Shiroro's back.
The sister of the Yakumo twins.
She enjoys flipping things on their head even more than Kuroku, and likes setting traps for pranks.
The woman working the bookstore. Intellectual and calm. Hard to get her attention when she's focused. Thinking about marriage, but her standards are too high, so she's starting to get impatient.
A girl who helps at the cafe. An easily-disoriented sort, and gets down about messing up, but she's trying to stay positive. Friendly with all kinds of people.
A boy who helps out at his parents' flower shop. A hard worker who's polite to everyone. His cheer and his smile never tire. He's lately been troubled by his inherited poor sense of direction.
Nanashi's cousin. He created the current Master Program, using his own custom programming language. He has a habit of writing notes on himself with red magic marker.
A strange girl who came from the future. The daughter of the Superintendent General of the Police, and apparently training to join the force. She seems calm, but she's fairly clumsy.
A boy who loves to sleep. Likes fighting, but won't bother when sleepy. He has a thoughtful friendly side too, and is in a band with some friends.
An android girl created by a certain researcher. Afterward, another person gave her a heart. Like her creators, she's a little zealous. She wishes to become a human.
An abandoned dog, swapped with a human by Izuchi. Her mind is currently that of a girl named Eruno Kyouka. She ran away from home often, so she doesn't seem to get on well with her parents.

segments.text: A young man skilled at programming. Ex-hacker. Has a wealth of programming/virus knowledge. Not very cooperative, and he speaks and acts rashly. His grandfather seemed to influence his speech.
A pretty smart boy. Ex-hacker. Stopped going to grade school, finding no point in study. Terrifyingly knowledgeable about programming. Has an older brother, but dislikes him.
A middle-aged guy running a cafe. Ex-hacker. He can do a little programming, apparently, but it's not like he knows that much. He can't say no to anyone, resulting in much suffering.
A refined woman. Ex-hacker. Seemingly freelance, doing all sorts of jobs. Her hacking, too, fell under this umbrella. Collected, and able to take a step back to observe.
Haruya's mother. A woman working at a flower shop. Haruya's mother, who takes things at her own pace. Really into making herb tea these days. She even has periodic tea parties.
A boy who lives at a planetarium. He was born without the use of his legs, and his parents live overseas. Doesn't seem great at talking to others, so his replies often come off as blunt.
A young gardener. It's not that he can't talk, but he can't be bothered, so his avatar talks for him. Rumor has it he's a pro wreath-maker.
A boy who immerses himself in baseball. He's been playing since a very young age, but his skill is average, if not worse. He goes to pet shops for healing on days when he doesn't have practice.
A shady woman living in a doll house. Her own lineage and history is unknown, but she's talented at putting heart into her dolls. Since she's not altogether there, hardly anyone comes near her.
A woman running a clothes shop. A famous designer who even works overseas, constantly paving the cutting edge. Sticks her neck into anything that interests her.
Akitaka's friend. Plays drums, and isn't good at string instruments. He has plenty of Larikkuma goods thanks to his friend, but he doesn't have much interest himself.
Akitaka's friend. Plays bass, and can't play guitar. He really loves Larikkuma, so his house is full of merchandise.
Akitaka's older sister. A college student who walks around eating on her days off. Trying to be on a diet, but she can't really keep it up.
A young man who immerses himself in arcades. First-class nationwide in fighting games, but he spends a lot of time and money getting there. Short-tempered, and may get rough
A girl who loves virus extermination. She has a future ambition to surpass the Master Program and eradicate all viruses and malware.
A novice reporter. Not very good at socializing. He lacks force, so he's bad at his job too. Always looking for soothing.
Akitaka's big brother. The leader of a gang. Appears scary, but he's thoughtful of his friends. Has a hard time waking up
A with-it gyaru. Not smart, but has innate power, so she can hold down her own in a fight. But she doesn't to avoid breaking nails.
A girl working as a pop idol. On break from her stage persona Tummy Tummy Ache. The name comes from her born weak stomach. She seems to have quite a longing for normality.
A woman working at an accessory shop. Always sleepy, even falling asleep on the job. She seems to need cat levels of sleep to function. She's slightly improved (?) lately.
A somewhat sick girl. Seeking someone who will love her, she's gone through many meetings and farewells. Very dependent, she wants things all to herself.
A young man, self-described genius. He is actually fairly intelligent, so he tends to look down on others. That really seeps into his personality.
A high-energy woman who tells fortunes. Has a staggering 20% success rate on fortunes. She mostly serves to console depressed people. That said, that seems to be what everyone is after.
A girl helping at a cake shop. Has a kind of pathetic personality and conduct. But she's weak to the old lady at the cake shop, and reluctantly acts normal when yelled at.
A young man working at a pet cafe.
Talks so quickly and energetically, it's hard to tell what he's saying sometimes. Animals are fond of him, which he also enjoys. He seems to be a pro at catching runaway animals.
